# ADR 0002: Two security filter chains: JWT for people, API keys for servers

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** Merchant onboarding and API key platform

## Context

Dashboard users and merchant servers authenticate differently and reach different endpoints.

## Decision

Two SecurityFilterChain beans ordered by path; the API-key chain uses a custom authentication filter.

## Consequences

Each mechanism stays simple and testable. Two configurations to maintain.

## Alternatives considered

One chain accepting both everywhere.
